input.summary: Build Transport Value before 1,000,000 points, lock two balls through R-E-S-C-U-E, then start Three-Ball Multiball and collect the red X and ordered Jackpot before the short multiplier timer ends.

quickInfo.name: R-E-S-C-U-E locks
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left R-E-S bank and center C-U-E bank, then shoot the left U.N. Orion ramp for each of two locks.

quickInfo.name: Three-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: With two balls locked, shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop to release all three balls.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot sequence
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, hit R, E, S, C, U, and E in order before one ball remains.

quickInfo.name: Transport Value
quickInfo.summary: Left-ramp shots and Transporter-cup spins build the award. A lit red X target collects it.

quickInfo.name: Score threshold
quickInfo.summary: After 1,000,000 points, drop, ramp, cup, and spinner values become less favorable. Build early.

quickInfo.name: Timed Playfield X
quickInfo.summary: Stock 3x and 2x scoring expire quickly. Prioritize the lit red X and the ordered R-E-S-C-U-E Jackpot sequence.

steps.text: Plunge softly into the spinner path. Retry when a short plunge returns to the shooter lane.
Cradle the first controlled return. Test the left ramp, Transporter scoop feed, and upper-right flipper strength.
Before reaching 1,000,000 points, use controlled cup spins and left-ramp shots to build Transport Value.
Shoot the left ramp while its lock is unlit to light the red X collect.
Complete R-E-S-C-U-E, then shoot the lit left ramp to lock ball 1.
Repeat R-E-S-C-U-E and the left ramp to lock ball 2.
Before starting multiball, keep Transport Value high and confirm that the red X target is lit.
Shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop to start Three-Ball Multiball.
Immediately collect the red X while stock 3x is active.
Hit R, E, S, C, U, and E in order for the stock Jackpot shown on the backglass.
Use any remaining 2x timer on the safest controlled repeat shot, then rebuild locks at one ball.

fallback.title: Stock single-ball Transport Value
fallback.when: Use this when drop-target rebounds or the lock ramp make multiball unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the Transporter scoop before two balls are locked.
Hold the upper-right flipper as the ball arrives.
Shoot the bridge into the cup for Transport Value advances.
Shoot the left ramp to add more advances and light the red X target.
Collect the red X before the score threshold reduces stock scoring.
Relight it with another left-ramp shot and repeat while the feed stays controlled.

alternatives.title: Direct stock multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when the drop targets and left ramp are safer than the upper bridge.

steps.text: Complete R-E-S-C-U-E and lock ball 1.
Repeat the target bank and lock ball 2.
Shoot the Transporter scoop to start Three-Ball Multiball.
Use the brief playfield multiplier on the red X if it is ready.
Complete R-E-S-C-U-E in order for Jackpot.

alternatives.title: S-O-S and end-of-ball bonus
alternatives.when: Use this when top-lane feeds are controlled and the major shots reject.

steps.text: Use lane change when enabled to complete the three S-O-S top lanes.
Each completion raises Bonus X by one through 5x.
After 5x, later completions can light the fixed center lane for Extra Ball.
Return up top through the spinner lane or a lower-right shot into the bumpers.
Preserve the ball because base bonus and Bonus X reset after the ball.

buildsToward.title: Early Transport Value and stock timed Multiball

steps.text: Build and light Transport Value before the 1,000,000-point scoring change.
Lock two balls through R-E-S-C-U-E and the left ramp.
Start Three-Ball Multiball at the Transporter scoop.
Collect the red X during the short 3x timer.
Complete ordered R-E-S-C-U-E for the stock Jackpot.

techniques.name: Repeatable skill plunge
techniques.instruction: Plunge softly into the spinner path below U.N. Orion, and retry when a short plunge returns to the shooter lane.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper trap
techniques.instruction: Hold the upper-right flipper as the Transporter scoop feeds it, then aim the bridge after the ball settles.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: Live catch the Transporter-scoop return on the left flipper before repeating the shot.

techniques.name: Post pass
techniques.instruction: Post pass a fast inlane return to the opposite flipper when the center-post rebound is controlled.

cautions.issue: Repeated Transporter shots can return without control and create a center drain.
cautions.response: Catch the return on the left flipper before another scoop attempt.

cautions.issue: The center-post transfer is not reliable and can send the ball between the flippers.
cautions.response: Test it once on a fast inlane feed, then stop if the transfer misses the opposite flipper.

checkBeforePlay: Test the upper-flipper trap, Transporter cup, scoop, and red X target.

input.simpleOverview: Transporter the Rescue uses the six R-E-S-C-U-E targets to light two left-ramp locks, then the Transporter scoop starts three-ball Multiball. Complete both target banks, take each lock at the left ramp, start at the scoop, then hit R-E-S-C-U-E in order for Jackpot.
input.overview: Transporter the Rescue uses the six R-E-S-C-U-E targets to light two left-ramp locks, then the Transporter scoop starts three-ball Multiball. Build and light the red-X collect before the second lock, start three-ball Multiball at the Transporter scoop, collect Transport Value while more balls remain, then complete R-E-S-C-U-E in order for Jackpot.
machineSetup: Test the upper-flipper trap, Transporter cup, scoop, and red X target.

content.summary: Complete both R-E-S-C-U-E drop banks and lock a ball at the left U.N. Orion ramp, repeat for a second lock, then shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop and complete R-E-S-C-U-E in order for the Multiball Jackpot.

steps.title: Lock two balls
steps.text: Complete the left R-E-S three-drop bank and the center C-U-E three-drop bank. Shoot the lit left U.N. Orion ramp to lock ball 1, then repeat both banks and the ramp to lock ball 2.

steps.title: Start Three-Ball Multiball
steps.text: With two balls locked, shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop. The scoop releases all three balls to the upper-right flipper and starts Three-Ball Multiball.

steps.title: Collect the Jackpot
steps.text: Before Multiball reaches one ball, hit the six drop targets in this order: R, E, S, C, U, E. Completing that ordered sequence collects the current Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: R-E-S-C-U-E locks
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left R-E-S bank and center C-U-E bank, then shoot the left U.N. Orion ramp for each of two locks.

quickInfo.name: Three-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: With two balls locked, shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop to release all three balls.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot sequence
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, hit R, E, S, C, U, and E in order before one ball remains.

warning.title: Drop-target rebounds can head between the flippers.
warning.text: After each hit on the left R-E-S or center C-U-E bank, keep both flippers ready before shooting the next letter.
